I recently stayed at "Hotel Samrat" and, unfortunately, had a very disappointing experience. From the moment I checked in, there were several issues that made my stay extremely uncomfortable.

First and foremost, the air conditioning was not working, which made the room unbearably hot and stuffy. Despite raising the issue with the staff, it was not resolved during my stay.

Secondly, the door lock was faulty, raising serious concerns about safety and privacy. I had to constantly double-check if the door was properly secured, which added unnecessary stress.

There were also frequent electricity issues, affecting not only the comfort but also my ability to get work done.

Additionally, I was surprised to find that basic amenities like a dental kit , electric kettle , Tea kit were not provided, which is expected even in budget accommodations.

The water flow in the bathroom was extremely slow, making it difficult to take a proper shower. This is a basic necessity that should be properly maintained.

Overall, my experience was far below expectations. I hope the hotel management takes these issues seriously and works on improving the facilities and guest experience. I would not recommend this property until these problems are addressed.
Overall Not Recommended
